bio: Frank D. Scott Jr. (born November 18, 1983) is an American politician who has been serving as the 73rd mayor of Little Rock, Arkansas since 2019. He is a member of the Democratic Party.

items.t: Continues to push for a new city sales tax; a new referendum was set for November 2024 after the 2021 measure was defeated.
items.q: Scott continues to push for a new sales tax and a date for a new referendum has been set for November 2024.

items.t: Proposed the "Rebuild the Rock" initiative, funded by a new sales tax to replace an expiring one, in his first term.
items.q: Scott proposed the "Rebuild the Rock" initiative, to be supported by a new sales tax to replace an expiring one.

items.t: Rebuild the Rock is meant to fund infrastructure and public parks improvements, a senior center, a sports complex, and first responder technology and equipment upgrades.
items.q: The initiative is meant to fund improvement of infrastructure and public parks, a senior center, sports complex, and upgrade technology and equipment used by first responders.
